RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; a defensible number cannot be inferred from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your longer experience matters, but years served don’t necessarily outweigh digital expertise, interview performance, or other selection criteria.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the assessment criteria, their weighting, and feedback on how your application compared against them. Check the broadcaster’s recruitment policy and any complaint deadlines; don’t assume awaiting a reply extends them.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks or inconsistent application of criteria—not simply because the panel and successful candidate were women.
